title: The Replica Trail
missionBriefing: The signal-web Deployment should serve three healthy replicas, but the rollout is stalled. Repair the workload while preserving the Deployment and its ownership chain.
successCriteria: Exactly three desired and three available replicas exist.
hints: Inspect the Deployment, its ReplicaSets, and Pod status before changing anything.
Compare the Pod template image with image-pull events, then repair the Deployment template.
